mostWorthwhile.text: Aerobic ATP renewal was the most worthwhile construction: it brought fuel oxidation, oxygen's role and the hydrogen-ion gradient together in one illustration plan.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing oxygen in the interior was straightforward but added little explanation on its own.

surprise.text: The glucose step produced pyruvate and ATP before oxygen was used, clearly separating glycolysis from the later aerobic process.

arbitrary.text: The separate oxygen placement felt a little procedural; the paired pyruvate-and-oxygen options with and without the interior also left their distinction unclear.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter: the contrast between passive channels and powered pumps made the constructions useful, although some preparations were routine.
